# origincloud_secret_manager_secret_versions (Data Source)

Lists a secret's versions, newest first, without their payloads. Destroyed ones are listed only when `show_deleted` is set. Needs `secretmanager.secret_version.list` on the secret.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project whose secret versions to list.
- `region` (String) The region whose secret versions to list.
- `secret` (String) The secret whose secret versions to list. Its `id`, the full resource name `//secretmanager.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/secrets/{secret}`. `project` and `region` must be the ones it is in.

### Read-Only

- `secret_versions` (Attributes List) The secret versions listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secret_versions))

<a id="nestedatt--secret_versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secret_versions`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String) When the version was added. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `destroy_time` (String) When the version's payload was destroyed; unset unless it is `DELETED`. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `id` (String) The secret version's full resource name, `//secretmanager.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/secrets/{secret}/versions/{version}`: what an argument that refers to the secret version takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `name` (String) The version's resource name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/secrets/{secret}/versions/{version}`, numbered from 1 in the order the versions were added. A request may name `versions/latest` instead of a number; a response always names the number.
- `state` (String) Whether the version's payload can be accessed. One of `ENABLED`, `DISABLED`, `DELETED`.
